name: Kusanagi Haku
source: Despite his insistence that he's lazy, the easygoing Hotarubi vice-captain is often in the position of being everyone's minder, and is frequently relied on to clean up his fellow students' messes. He is the heir to a prominent Shinto shrine, and often sees things others can't.
